weather_report:
As Boston continues to awaken under a drab, gray canvas, a persistent drizzle punctuates the early hours. The air is thick and damp, with the promise of more rain throughout the day, wrapping the city in a cloak of humidity and patchy fog. The cloying clouds sit like an uninvited guest, veiling the skyline, blurring the edges of familiar buildings. Today’s high will barely graze the mid-sixties, leaving little room for warmth in the air; the low tonight will mirror this cool embrace, settling close to fifty-five as the drizzle dissipates but the fog lingers, casting a ghostly hue over the evening.

In such weather, layers will be your ally. A light waterproof jacket serves well against the rain, while a cozy sweater offers refuge against the chill. An umbrella may be a necessary companion, though it might as well be a ship at sea—adrift in the wind and constant gray. With the world outside dull and muted, consider a leisurely stroll through the quiet streets; the charm of Boston under a light rain has a tranquil beauty all its own. Perhaps ducking into a local café for a warm cup of coffee or finding solace in a quiet bookshop can transform this overcast day into a cozy retreat. Let the rain be a reminder to savor the small moments, as the city rolls through the day in its own rhythmic pulse of muted charm.
